title: California 'lost shark guy', 68, names 56 species, hunts fish unseen since 1926
summary_full: For decades, marine biologist David Ebert has journeyed to fish markets worldwide, uncovering the mysteries of sharks and rays. His remarkable contributions include documenting 56 new species, revealing the astonishing diversity of marine life. Ebert passionately advocates for recognizing the neglected shark species, underlining the integral role they play in maintaining healthy ocean ecosystems and the threats they face from human activities.
